interface.signature: arr: List[str], n: int, str: str, k: int -> int

preconditions.description: The size of the array arr must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 1000 for s in arr)
preconditions.description: Each string in arr must have a length between 1 and 1000.
The length of the string str must be between 1 and 1000.
The integer k must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(s.islower() and s.isalpha() for s in arr) and str.islower() and str.isalpha()
preconditions.description: All strings in arr and str must contain only lowercase English alphabets.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of strings in arr whose prefix of length k matches the k-length prefix of str.
